newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Highlights of Wednesday's Commission briefing.
newsitem.headline: Highlights of Wednesday's Commission briefing.

text.p: Following are highlights of the midday briefing by the European Commission on Wednesday:
Spokesman Nikolaus van der Pas said the Commission had formally cleared the Boeing/McDonell Douglas merger. Van der Pas said there had been no debate on this case.
Van der Pas said the Commission had appointed Bernhard Zepter as Commission Assistant Secretary General and Jose Manuel Silva Rodriguez as DGVI Deputy Director General.
In answer to a question van der Pas said former DGVI Deputy Director General Fernando Mansito Caballero had been asked to leave "in the service's interest" two weeks ago.
In answer to a question, spokesman Willy Helin said he had received no new information on the Credit Lyonnais restructuring plan.

Spokeswoman Sarah Lambert, speaking about the court case against Austria, said the Commission believed Austria's Brenner motorway tariffs were discriminatory and were not in relation with existing Community law. Lambert said the Commission had no idea how the Court would find and that were the Court to find in favour of the Commission, there was no reason to suppose Austria would not comply with the decision.
The Commission released the following documents:
- IP/97/717: Outlook for EU audiovisual policy.
- IP/97/718: Commission modifies the "Birds" directive with respect to the great cormorant.
- IP/97/719: Convention on admission of third country citizens.
- IP/97/721: Commission takes Austria to court over Brenner motorway tolls.
- IP/97/722: The Commission proposes a budget of 16.3 billion ecus for the forthcoming 5th framework programme for research and technological development.
- IP/97/723: State aid: France - the Commission approves GAN's restructuring plan.
- IP/97/724: Comission releases first instalment of restructuring aid for MTW Schiffswerft in Wismar and Volkswerft in Stralsund under the programme approved by the Council in June 1997.
- IP/97/725: State aid: Spain - Commission takes final decision against Asterillos Zamacona.
- IP/97/726: State aid: France - Commission decides to investigate restructuring aid in favour of Lainiere de Roubaix.
- IP/97/727: State aid: France - Commission approves R&D aid for Eurocopter for the development of a new generation of helicopters.
- IP/97/728: Commission opens procedure against investment grants from the State of Brandenburg to promote the use of lignite.
- IP/97/729: The Commission clears the merger between Boeing and McDonnell Douglas under conditions and obligations.
- ME97/30.7: Midday Express.
